A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Asian energy system is highly vulnerable to climate change and its impacts, and that the energy sector has a large potential to mitigate climate change, but that the mitigation potential will be difficult to realize without a strong policy focus on energy security, energy poverty, and air pollution.
climate change mitigation is not the only, and not even the most important, driver of the Asian energy system.

climate change mitigation and air pollution abatement are best achieved by reducing the energy intensity of the economy, which in turn depends on the energy intensity of electricity supply, and the choice of technologies to generate electricity.

the Asian energy system is a complex system with multiple synergies and trade-offs.
